possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card states the model was trained on the first 200,000 samples from a Fineweb dump (CC-MAIN-2024-18), but gives no provenance details or verification of the source/usage terms for those samples.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card names the dataset and sample count but does not document collection, curation, filtering, or preprocessing details for the 200,000 Fineweb samples.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card provides no information about how the Fineweb samples were collected, curated, or used to train this checkpoint, making model behavior harder to explain.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: Training on only the first 200,000 samples from one Fineweb dump may not represent the broader population or the full diversity of the source corpus, potentially limiting generalization.

specifications.model_size: 0.5 GiB of safetensors weights (538,090,408 bytes) in F32

training_context.training_data: The model is a pre-trained version of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M, trained on the first 200,000 samples from the Fineweb dataset dump CC-MAIN-2024-18.
